messages:
maria: quick q — how do operators see *why* an automatic fallback ran? need something audit-friendly (which quota, which error trigger, model variant chosen)
aj: we currently emit an event to ops-log and a short row in rollout-telemetry. but i agree it's sparse.
samir: +1. auditors ask for the chain: request -> policy eval -> trigger reason -> chosen fallback. can we surface a single trace id?
maria: trace id would be ideal. then the console could fetch full playback.
aj: arch idea: policy-eval generates decision_id. it ties to request_id, sample_kv, and the fallback decision. we can store that in the audit index.
ops-bot: [automated] decision_id created: d-1767800000-9f3a; stored in audit-log (retention: 90d) :white_check_mark:
tanya: UX question — where does that decision_id live in the console? route details panel? a new "handoff" tab?
liam: route panel + a compact "why fallback" flyout. show short summary + link to full playbook (decision_id).
maria: summary should include: trigger (error code or quota), detected latency/sla breach, fallback target, sampling rate, operator override history.
samir: for quota triggers we need to include the exact meter: e.g., "dedicated-gpu-pool.xfer:95pct" — that was asked by compliance last time.
aj: agreed. also include pre/post token cost estimate and whether kv-cache was hit. small but important for billing reconciliations.
tanya: on the console side i'll prototype a compact breadcrumb: [policy v3.4] -> [eval: throttled] -> [action: route->cheap-variant] -> [decision_id]. click to expand logs + telemetry.
liam: can we also add a small timeline with SLO metrics +/- 30s around decision? helps ops correlate incidents.
maria: yes. and we should persist a human note when an operator overrides the fallback (who, why). that'll help postmortems.
aj: implementation notes: decision_id will be indexed in clickhouse for fast query, full playback stored in object storage. index fields: timestamp, route, decision_id, trigger_type, trigger_meta, chosen_model, operator_id (optional).
samir: API changes: we should extend admin API: GET /decisions/{decision_id} -> returns a compact JSON payload + links to raw playback (signed url). sample:```
{
  "decision_id": "d-1767800000-9f3a",
  "route": "chat-prod-us",
  "trigger": "quota::dedicated-gpu-pool.xfer",
  "trigger_value": "0.95",
  "action": "route:small-quantized-v2",
  "operator_override": null
}
```
tanya: console can call that API. prefer a short payload for quick UI render and a raw blob for debugging.
liam: telemetry sampling — we can't keep full request bodies for all decisions. propose: 1% full playback sampling + always store metadata + ability to fetch raw for customer-initiated audits (with auth).
maria: compliance: they want guaranteed retention of decision metadata for 7 years for some customers. need opt-in export to paper-trail (SaaS add-on).
aj: we'll add a policy flag: audit_export: [none, 90d, 7y]. default 90d. 7y requires legal/ops signoff.
samir: edge case: if fallback was due to a model crash (OOM), trigger_type should include error stack ref and a link to crash dump. not the raw dump inline.
ops-bot: [automated] new field proposal recorded in RFC: rfc-autofallback-decision-schema-2026. link: https://intra.redwood/rfcs/523
maria: one more UI ask — add a tiny "why did you fallback" toast for developers when their request is sampled (links to decision_id). helps reduce PM follow-ups.
tanya: +1. also allow filter in route dashboard for "fallbacks by trigger" and "fallbacks by operator override".
liam: production concern: indexing too many fields could spike cost. aj can we compress trigger_meta into tags: e.g., "quota:d-pool:xfer:0.95" so indexing stays small?
aj: yes, we'll use a tag+kv model. full playback in blob only.
samir: API contract: we must ensure decision_id is idempotent and unique per policy-eval. if a request gets retried, we may have multiple decision ids — link them via request_id parent.
maria: sounds good. timeline for this?
aj: I'll draft RFC + schema this week. storage pipeline needs ~2 sprints for index + blob storage. UI prototype from tanya in 1 sprint. ops export and 7y retention is a follow-up.
tanya: will mock up the flyout and toast by Thu, share in #eng-platform for feedback.
liam: i'll run a cost estimate for indexing 100M decisions/month and post numbers.
maria: thanks all. this should finally make handoffs auditable and less mysterious for customers + ops. :party-parrot:
aj: one quick note — need product to sign off on export levels for compliance customers. pinging @product for sync after RFC.
ops-bot: [automated] thread archived after 7 days of inactivity.
